title: Pip and the Little Bug
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters st, sw, tr.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow trotting along a puddle-dotted path.
Pip spotting a tiny unfamiliar bug on the path ahead.
Pip looking closely at the small bug, having never seen one like it before.
Pip the sparrow tapping the bug gently with his beak.
Pip the sparrow picking up a small bit of the bug.
Pip stopping still, considering the new taste.
Pip comparing the bug’s taste to a nut in his mind, clearly different.
Pip the sparrow taking one more little bit.
Pip the sparrow looking pleased, having enjoyed his unusual snack.
